27. Arrange the following into historical sequence and select the correct answer from the codes given below:
1. Chalcolithic age
2. Iron age
3. Bronze age
4. Stone age
questions.explanation:
Chronological sequence:

| Period | Timeframe |
|---|---|
| Stone Age | 2.6 million years ago to 3700 B.C. |
| Chalcolithic Age | About 4000 B.C. to 3000 B.C. |
| Bronze Age | 3300 B.C. - 1200 B.C. |
| Iron Age | 1500 B.C. - 600 B.C. |

questions.questionText:
29. Arrange the following Gods in order of their importance in the Rig Vedic Society and select the correct answer from the codes given below:
1. Agni
2. Varuna
3. Indra
4. Marut
questions.explanation:
Chronological order of Gods in order of importance:
3. Indra (Indra was most important rigvedic God and also known as purandar)
1. Agni
2. Varuna
4. Marut

questions.unitName: Unit 6: Society and Culture in Medieval India
questions.questionText:
31. What is the correct chronological sequence of the following Bhakti saints?
1. Chaitanya
2. Ramanuja
3. Tukaram
4. Namdev
questions.explanation:
Chronological sequence of Bhakti poets:
2. Ramanuja (12th century)
4. Namdev (1270-1350)
1. Chaitanya (1486-1533)
3. Tukaram (1608-1650)

questions.unitName: Unit 5: Administration & Economy in Medieval India
questions.questionText:
32. What is the correct sequence of the following events related to Shivaji?
1. Treaty of Purandhar
2. First Plunder of Surat
3. Coronation
4. Visit to Agra
questions.explanation:
Chronological sequence of events related to Shivaji:
2. First plunder of Surat (1664)
1. Treaty of Purandhar (1665)
4. Visit to Agra (1666)
3. Coronation (1674)

questions.questionText:
35. Arrange the following wars in chronological order using the codes given below:
1. First Burma War
2. First Anglo-Afghan War
3. First Anglo-Maratha War
4. First Anglo-Sikh War
questions.explanation:
Chronological order of Battles:
3. First Anglo Maratha War (1775-82 A.D.)
1. First Burma War (1824-26 A.D.)
2. First Anglo Afghan War (1839-42 A.D.)
4. First Anglo Sikh War (1845-1846 A.D.)

questions.questionText:
36. Arrange the following organizations by the year of their foundation:
1. British Indian Association
2. Poona Sarvajanik Sabha
3. Madras Mahajan Sabha
4. Indian Association
questions.explanation:
Foundation timeline:
1. British Indian Association - 1851 by Radhakant Deb
2. Poona Sarvajanik Sabha - 1867 by M.G. Ranade
4. Indian Association - 1876 by S.N. Bannerjee
3. Madras Mahajan Sabha - 1884 by V. Raghavachari
